prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the mold from mobile robot platform to workbench.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether a mold is on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A laboratory workstation photographed at close range. At the top hangs a white sign reading "Synthesis Workstation" with Chinese characters above it, and a purple square panel bearing a black-and-white fiducial marker (ArUco-style) at its left end. Below the sign, two black vertical posts descend to a grey aluminium extrusion frame.

On a raised black rack at upper right stand five small tubes in a row, each capped with an orange cap; they appear empty or clear.

In the foreground are grey metal modules with white top plates. A white rectangular block sits on the left bench section, and a short white cylindrical cap-like piece sits to its right. A vertical grey panel carries another black-and-white marker label. Silver metal connectors project from the module faces.
observations: The description does not mention a mold being present on the workbench, only a white rectangular block, a cylindrical cap, and some tubes.

args.observations: The description does not mention a mold being present on the workbench, only a white rectangular block, a cylindrical cap, and some tubes.
